text:
claire: heads-up: we're flipping the slim-kernel build (slim-kernel:v2 + quant-2.1.1) during the 02:00-03:00 UTC change window. rollout plan: 3% canary -> 20% -> 50% -> full. 10m holds on each stage.
omar: i'll own the rollout steps and comms. riley watches perf dashboards and alerts.
riley: i'll add p99 decode, mem growth, and kv-cache miss rate to the watchlist. also enabling extra logging for the first canary hosts.
claire: rollback policy: immediate rollback to slim-kernel:v1 if errors >3% absolute or p99 regresses >50ms sustained across two metrics intervals. pin last-stable for 4h post-widen.
deploybot: [deploybot] scheduled: image=slim-kernel:v2 quant=2.1.1 window=02:00-03:00 UTC slices=3%,20%,50%,100% pin_TTL=0
claire: set pin_TTL=4h and annotate release "slim-kernel:v2: improved startup latency, possible scheduler sensitivity"
deploybot: [deploybot] updated: pin_TTL=4h annotation added
omar: running preflight now: short/long prompt smoke, embedding checksum, kv-cache warmup.
infra-bot: [infra-bot] preflight-run #334 passed: 5 checks OK
omar: starting 3% canary in 5m. i'll post updates on slice transitions.
deploybot: [deploybot] slice=3% started at 3467891500 by omar
riley: first minute: no crashes, p99 +8ms, mem steady. kv-miss slightly higher (3%) on canary hosts.
claire: ok to proceed to 20% if no error rise. watch the kv-miss trend.
deploybot: [deploybot] slice=20% started at 3467891800
riley: at 20% p99 +22ms, kv-miss 5% on average but concentrated on a subset of hosts. investigating host labels.
omar: can we route around the subset? if it's small, we can continue with caution.
infra-bot: [infra-bot] hostgroup-orphan: hostpool-us-west-7 has older OS image on ~0.6% of hosts
riley: that hostpool correlates with elevated kv-miss. looks like compatibility issue with older kernel shim.
claire: pause at 20% hold. omar, can you coordinate a quick routing rule to avoid pool-us-west-7 while we patch?
omar: creating a route override now. applying route: avoid=pool-us-west-7 for slim-kernel:v2
deploybot: [deploybot] route override applied
riley: after routing, kv-miss back to baseline and p99 stable ~+12ms.
claire: since we mitigated, proceed to 50% but keep the hold windows. if the issue reappears, rollback immediately.
deploybot: [deploybot] slice=50% started at 3467892050
riley: 50% looks fine so far. small noise on p99 but within thresholds. no new alerts.
omar: scheduling full widen at 02:45 UTC.
deploybot: [deploybot] slice=100% scheduled for 3467892300
claire: final checks: ensure last-stable tag points to slim-kernel:v1 and sticky pin is set for 4h after widen. zoe in infra has last-stable digest?
omar: tagged v1->last-stable: sha256:9f8d3a2b
deploybot: [deploybot] slice=100% started at 3467892300
riley: post-widen metrics: p99 +14ms, errors flat, kv-miss normalized. infra logs show the routing change removed the noisy hosts.
claire: good. post-deploy: create a short ops note with the routing workaround and follow-up to update OS image on pool-us-west-7. keep pin for 4h.
omar: will file infra ticket and follow-up. closing thread after 1h if no regressions. thanks team.
